summary: Phase S3 has one Blocker. The placement of the dispositions line conflicts between contracts.md and the test strategy, so a literal follow-up breaks the role gate. The worked example in contracts.md also misstates the keep rule for an unrouted finding. F8 and F9 are closed. F7 stays open until F10 is fixed. The S3 docs test could not run.

contract_applicability.basis: Phase S3 changes the finding disposition contract, the agent prompts that carry it, and the checker that reads it.

blocking_findings: F11 [Blocker] measure/tracks/spec_review_gate_20261030/test-strategy.md:193 and plan.md:173: Both files say the optional dispositions line goes below the Agent Result Block template. contracts.md:108 and the checker require the line inside the block, before END_MEASURE_AGENT_RESULT. contracts.md:120 states that a line after END does not count. Rationale: A verifier or implementer who follows the track text places the line outside the block, so role-gate ignores it and the disposition check fails.
nonblocking_findings: F10 [Major] skills/measure-orchestrator/references/contracts.md:133-137: The worked example says the re-review keeps its own F3 and writes the CONTEST kept suffix. The keep rule at contracts.md:143-144 applies only to routed CONTEST items. F3 is a new finding, not a routed item. Rationale: An agent that copies the example writes a CONTEST kept line for a finding that was never contested. F7 stays open until this example is corrected.
F12 [Nit] skills/measure-orchestrator/references/contracts.md:147: The No FIX item paragraph states the same-HEAD fact twice. Rationale: The repeated sentence adds length without new rule text.
closed_findings: F8: Closed by 011b92c. contracts.md:114 states that the line is optional in general and required when the brief held routed findings.
F9: Closed by 011b92c. contracts.md:147 states that a round with no FIX item runs the re-review on the same HEAD.
